title: Large-Scale User Behavior Analysis in Multimodal AI-Assisted Manual Task Execution
abstract: arXiv:2609.07594v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conversational Task Assistants (CTAs) are multimodal dialogue systems that support users in complex real-world tasks such as cooking and DIY through voice, text, image, and video interactions. Prior user studies have focused on controlled settings, leaving limited understanding of real-world CTA usage at scale. In this work, we present a large-scale study of CTA usage based on thousands of users in-the-wild. Our large-scale real-world data analysis unveils new understandings of (i) user-CTA interaction flows, (ii) user intents, (iii) user conversational traits, and (iv) behavioral factors associated with user satisfaction. Our findings reveal key opportunities for future research in CTAs, particularly in user interaction design and task engagement, concluding with concrete design guidelines.

translated_title: 多模态AI辅助手工任务执行中的大规模用户行为分析
translated_abstract: 对话式任务助手是多模态对话系统，通过语音、文本、图像和视频交互，支持用户完成烹饪和DIY等复杂的现实世界任务。以往的用户研究主要聚焦于受控环境，对真实世界中大规模CTA实际使用的理解十分有限。在本工作中，我们基于数千名真实用户开展了大规模的CTA使用研究。我们的大规模真实数据分析揭示了以下方面的新认识：(i) 用户与CTA的交互流程，(ii) 用户意图，(iii) 用户对话特征，以及 (iv) 与用户满意度相关的行为因素。我们的发现揭示了CTA未来研究的关键机遇，特别是在用户交互设计和任务参与方面，并最终给出了具体的设计指南。
tldr: 本文通过对数千名真实用户的大规模真实环境研究，首次系统揭示了对话式任务助手的用户交互流程、用户意图、对话特征及满意度相关的行为因素，并据此提出了具体的设计指南。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale in-the-wild study of thousands of users, unveiling new insights into user-CTA interaction flows, user intents, conversational traits, and behavioral factors associated with user satisfaction, and concluding with concrete design guidelines.
